reviewSamples.author: Photo of R
reviewSamples.text: I live in South Florida and needed electrical work done at my townhouse at University Green. I reached out to the Mr. James at Macon Electric, who was ver professional, courteous, and knowledgeable. Mr. James was prompt and the price was reasonable for the work done. I will definitely use Macon Electric for future projects if needed.
